en: This is a vintage postcard with a sepia-toned image depicting a Renaissance-style architectural courtyard featuring arched arcades, ornate windows, columns, and a small dome structure. The setting is sunlit, showing detailed masonry and shadow patterns. There are people present, suggesting an open, public area. At the bottom left, 'KÜNSTLERKARTE' is printed, while on the bottom right, it reads 'GRAZ LANDHAUSHOF.'
